groups.why: Both state that without Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, a credentialed simple GET response is ignored and unavailable to web content.
Both say that cookies in CORS requests or responses are subject to third-party cookie policies.
The second sentence specifies the seconds unit for the cache duration described in the first.
The second sentence identifies the complementary response header for the request header described in the first.
